name: Low Lunge
description: Hold a kneeling lunge to stretch the front of the rear hip while keeping the trunk upright.

items.content: Step one foot forward from kneeling; place the front knee over the ankle and cushion the rear knee.
Keep the feet hip-width apart rather than on one narrow line.
Gently tuck the pelvis and tighten the rear glute, keeping the ribs above the pelvis.
Shift forward only until a mild stretch appears at the front of the rear hip; avoid arching the back.
Rest hands on the front thigh for balance, breathe, and repeat on the other side.

stages.name: Hold
stages.description: Half-kneeling with front foot flat, front knee above ankle and rear knee on a folded mat behind the hip. Torso upright, pelvis facing forward and hands resting on the front thigh.
